name: io.github.Fieldproxy/fieldproxy-mcp
title: Fieldproxy
description: Field service management: jobs, dispatch, invoices, quotes and building apps, confirm before change.

environmentVariables.name: FIELDPROXY_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your workspace's MCP address, e.g. https://api-us-east-1.fieldproxy.ai/mcp. Leave unset to use the public read-only sandbox.

environmentVariables.name: FIELDPROXY_MCP_KEY
environmentVariables.description: An fpmcp.… key from Settings, AI assistant, New key. Leave unset to use the public read-only sandbox.
